test_contract: Grouped synthetic scenarios cover normative mechanisms without asserting implementation APIs. Instantiate actual native fixtures when admitted. Fixture inability/permission failure is blocked/not_run, never passing native proof. Error spelling may map to stable equivalent product codes; semantic allow/deny/refuse and preserved objects are binding.
no_new_authority: No hostwide tracing, cross-user privilege grants, source ACL mutation or production data operations authorized by these fixtures.
final_acceptance: Both native OS executions and relevant exact input/output/test receipts required; scoped partial artifact handoff is not full T24/product acceptance.

review.scope: Independent oracle review; requested concrete corrections adjudicated, no native implementation/API approval.

policy_profiles.private_owner: current user by default; verified corresponding SYSTEM/admin role only under explicit disclosed host-admin policy, never arbitrary foreign owner
policy_profiles.private_ACE: Mechanical trusted allow-list; narrow inherit-only owner placeholders only when trusted-owner substitution proven; deny ACE does not offset foreign allow
policy_profiles.ancestor: Assess replacement-capable rights and admitted root pinning, not private ACL on every ancestor
policy_profiles.Linux_leaf: Declared leaf mode policy + effective access under protected parent; library-managed files require verified privacy/configuration, no global runtime umask mutation
policy_profiles.Windows_filesystem: Baseline supported NTFS profile with stable held identity; ReFS requires full128bit file ID proof or explicit unadmitted-FS refusal
policy_profiles.source_SQLite: No application data/schema/checkpoint/journal-mode or missing sidecar creation; only admitted existing lock/readmark protocol activity, source-wide byte-preservation not falsely claimed
policy_profiles.lock: Acquire proves no conflicting held lock, never earlier process death; writer protocol/identity required; OS lock not invented historical custody
policy_profiles.crash: Inline receipt only graceful stop; hard-crash orphan receipt during next-start recovery
